as_told.title: Musgrave sees snake-like things in space

plain: Kevin Knuth, a guest on a podcast episode about NASA (the US space agency) and hidden UFO data, passes on the story of Musgrave, a pilot on the Space Shuttle, the American spacecraft that carried crews into orbit. Knuth says Musgrave spoke of seeing things like snakes out in space. The podcast host, Jesse Michels, repeats the story in nearly the same words. If true, it would mean something moving, maybe even alive, is out there around the Earth.
